item.tib: kun mkhyen chen po shar rdza 'ja' lus pa'i bla sgrub 'dod 'byung rin chen gyi tshogs 'khor 'don thabs
item.coloph: de ltar pho tshod rang bzo ma yin te/ 'ja' lus gong mas zhal rgyun phyag len ltar/ mched grogs rnams la phan ched 'don thabs 'di/ kho bo bu ming pa des bris pa yin/ bkra shis dge l-igs srid mthar rgyas gyur cig/
